why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Connect a wallet on the Airdrop page Go to the OpenZK Airdrop page , then link a wallet to view your Airdrop Points, multipliers and missions.
2 Step 2 : Follow OpenZK on X and join its Telegram Complete the social missions by following OpenZK on X and joining the OpenZK Telegram .
3 Step 3 : Bridge ETH or stablecoins Use the OpenZK bridge to move ETH or supported stablecoins to the network. A first bridge is its own mission, and the balance tiers count ozETH and ozUSD held.
4 Step 4 : Keep your assets bridged and staked The multiplier on the Airdrop page keeps growing each week your ETH or stablecoin stays in place, so check the page again later.
5 Step 5 : Invite friends with your referral code Get a code from the Invites section of the Airdrop page. As a referrer, you earn a 15% share of the points your invitees collect.
